func _update_slot_display(i: int) -> void:
	var atype: String   = _slots[i]["type"]
	var aname: String   = _slots[i]["ability"]
	var name_lbl: Label = _slots[i]["name_lbl"]
	var type_lbl: Label = _slots[i]["type_lbl"]
	var bg: StyleBoxFlat = _slots[i]["bg"]

	if aname.is_empty():
		name_lbl.text     = ""
		type_lbl.text     = ""
		bg.border_color   = Color(0.35, 0.35, 0.45)
		return

	var display := aname.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
	if display.length() > 12:
		var parts := display.split(" ", true, 1)
		display = "\n".join(parts)
	name_lbl.text = display

	match atype:
		"spell":
			type_lbl.text   = "S"
			bg.border_color = Color(0.55, 0.45, 0.25)   # gold — spell
		"skill":
			type_lbl.text   = "K"
			bg.border_color = Color(0.3, 0.55, 0.3)     # green — skill
		_:
			type_lbl.text   = ""
			bg.border_color = Color(0.35, 0.35, 0.45)


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_player):
		var players := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("player")
		if players.is_empty():
			return
		_player = players[0]
		_refresh_slots()
		return

	var spell_cds: Dictionary = _player.get("_spell_cooldowns") if "_spell_cooldowns" in _player else {}
	var skill_cds: Dictionary = _player.get("_skill_cooldowns") if "_skill_cooldowns" in _player else {}

	for i in range(SLOT_COUNT):
		var atype: String  = _slots[i]["type"]
		var aname: String  = _slots[i]["ability"]
		if aname.is_empty():
			continue
		var cd: float = spell_cds.get(aname, 0.0) if atype == "spell" else skill_cds.get(aname, 0.0)
		var on_cd := cd > 0.01
		_slots[i]["cd_overlay"].visible = on_cd
		_slots[i]["cd_lbl"].visible     = on_cd
		if on_cd:
			_slots[i]["cd_lbl"].text = "%.1f" % cd


func _refresh_slots() -> void:
	var bar: Array = _player.get("action_bar_slots") if "action_bar_slots" in _player else []
	for i in range(SLOT_COUNT):
		if i < bar.size():
			var slot: Dictionary = bar[i]
			_slots[i]["type"]    = slot.get("type", "")
			_slots[i]["ability"] = slot.get("name", "")
		else:
			_slots[i]["type"]    = ""
			_slots[i]["ability"] = ""
		_update_slot_display(i)

# action_bar.gd — Bottom-center HUD bar showing ability slots (spells + skills)
extends CanvasLayer

const SLOT_COUNT  := 12
const SLOT_SIZE   := 62
const SLOT_GAP    := 4

var _slots: Array[Dictionary] = []
var _player: Node = null
var _slot_panels: Array[Control] = []
var _panel: Panel = null
var _dragging := false


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 4
	_build_ui()


func _on_panel_gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		_dragging = event.pressed
		if not _dragging:
			_save_position()
	elif event is InputEventMouseMotion and _dragging:
		_panel.offset_left   += event.relative.x
		_panel.offset_top    += event.relative.y
		_panel.offset_right  += event.relative.x
		_panel.offset_bottom += event.relative.y


func _save_position() -> void:
	if Global.player_data.is_empty():
		return
	var ui: Dictionary = Global.player_data.get("ui_positions", {})
	ui["action_bar"] = [_panel.offset_left, _panel.offset_top, _panel.offset_right, _panel.offset_bottom]
	Global.player_data["ui_positions"] = ui
	Global.save_player_data_to_file()


func _load_position() -> void:
	var pos: Array = Global.player_data.get("ui_positions", {}).get("action_bar", [])
	if pos.size() == 4:
		_panel.offset_left   = pos[0]
		_panel.offset_top    = pos[1]
		_panel.offset_right  = pos[2]
		_panel.offset_bottom = pos[3]

		key_lbl.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		slot_panel.add_child(key_lbl)

		slot_panel.add_child(type_lbl)

		return

	var display := aname.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
	if display.length() > 12:
		var parts := display.split(" ", true, 1)
		display = "\n".join(parts)
	name_lbl.text = display

	match atype:
		"spell":
			type_lbl.text   = "S"
			bg.border_color = Color(0.55, 0.45, 0.25)   # gold — spell
		"skill":
			type_lbl.text   = "K"
			bg.border_color = Color(0.3, 0.55, 0.3)     # green — skill
		_:
			type_lbl.text   = ""
			bg.border_color = Color(0.35, 0.35, 0.45)


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_player):
		var players := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("player")
		if players.is_empty():
			return
		_player = players[0]
		_refresh_slots()
		return

	var spell_cds: Dictionary = _player.get("_spell_cooldowns") if "_spell_cooldowns" in _player else {}
	var skill_cds: Dictionary = _player.get("_skill_cooldowns") if "_skill_cooldowns" in _player else {}

	for i in range(SLOT_COUNT):
		var atype: String  = _slots[i]["type"]
		var aname: String  = _slots[i]["ability"]
		if aname.is_empty():
			continue
		var cd: float = spell_cds.get(aname, 0.0) if atype == "spell" else skill_cds.get(aname, 0.0)
		var on_cd := cd > 0.01
		_slots[i]["cd_overlay"].visible = on_cd
		_slots[i]["cd_lbl"].visible     = on_cd
		if on_cd:
			_slots[i]["cd_lbl"].text = "%.1f" % cd


func _refresh_slots() -> void:
	var bar: Array = _player.get("action_bar_slots") if "action_bar_slots" in _player else []
	for i in range(SLOT_COUNT):
		if i < bar.size():
			var slot: Dictionary = bar[i]
			_slots[i]["type"]    = slot.get("type", "")
			_slots[i]["ability"] = slot.get("name", "")
		else:
			_slots[i]["type"]    = ""
			_slots[i]["ability"] = ""
		_update_slot_display(i)

content.text:
All good. Here's a summary of everything that changed:

---

**Right-click to auto-equip** (`slot_button.gd`)
- Right-clicking an equippable item (weapon, armor, etc.) now calls `Inventory.equip_item()` directly
- Right-clicking a non-equippable item (consumables, misc) still opens the inspect popup

**Window position saving** (`game_log_window.gd`, `action_bar.gd`)
- On mouse-button-release after a drag, each window writes its 4 panel offsets into `Global.player_data["ui_positions"]["chat"]` / `["action_bar"]` and calls `Global.save_player_data_to_file()`
- On startup each window reads those offsets back and repositions itself — so layout is per-character

**Pause / save menu** (`pause_menu.gd` + `pause_menu.tscn`, `player3d.gd`)
- **Escape** opens the pause menu (a centered modal with a dim overlay)
- **Save Game**: writes the save file, logs "Game saved." to the General chat tab, closes menu
- **Save and Exit**: writes the save file then changes scene to `main_menu.tscn`
- **Resume**: closes the menu (Escape also works to dismiss)
- The menu is layer 20 so it always renders on top of everything

1	## 2026-06-08 — Session 2: Combat fixes, HUD improvements, action bar
2	
3	### Bug Fixes
4	
5	**combatnode.gd — `class_name` reserved keyword crash**
6	- `func set_class(class_name: String)` used a GDScript reserved keyword as a parameter.
7	- Renamed parameter to `new_class`. Game was unlaunchable until this fix.
8	
9	**player_frame.gd — `get()` too many arguments**
10	- `_player.get("current_stamina", 0.0)` — GDScript's Object.get() takes 1 arg, not 2.
11	- Changed to ternary `_player.get("x") if "x" in _player else default`.
12	
13	**combatnode.gd — ATK stat double-counted in damage**
14	- `calculate_melee_damage()` added `get_atk()` to raw damage.
15	- ATK is a hit-accuracy stat used in `calculate_hit_chance()`, not a damage bonus.
16	- Monsters had `gear_atk = 40 + level×10`; a level-2 skeleton was dealing 60+ base damage.
17	- Fix: removed `get_atk()` from damage formula. Damage is now `weapon_damage + str/2`.
18	
19	**monster3d.gd — monster hit rate too high**
20	- `gear_atk = 40 + level×10` gave skeleton ~95% hit rate vs player AC 14.
21	- Changed to `gear_atk = 15 + level×5` (level-2 skeleton now ~55-60% hit rate).
22	
23	**project.godot — A/D keys mapped to ui_left/ui_right**
24	- Caused TabContainer in game_log_window to switch tabs while strafing.
25	- Removed physical_keycode 65 (A) from ui_left and 68 (D) from ui_right.
26	- Arrow keys remain bound; A/D now only fire player movement actions.
27	
28	**camera_controller.gd — mouse_mode conflict with Alt toggle**
29	- Removed Alt-key mouse toggle (unreliable).
30	- Replaced with right-click-hold for mouse look: MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED while held,
31	  MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE on release. Default mode is now VISIBLE (cursor free).
32	
33	---
34	
35	### New Features
36	
37	**Combat log formatting**
38	- Monster attacks: "A hooded bandit hits you for 12 damage!" (description from monsters.json)
39	- Player attacks: "You hit/critically hit a hooded bandit with melee attack for X damage!"
40	- Parry/block/dodge/riposte all have distinct messages.
41	- `monster_description` field loaded from monsters.json in monster3d.gd.
42	
43	**Autoattack indicator**
44	- Flashing red dot (⬤) added to top-right of game_log_window panel.
45	- Animated via Tween (fade in/out). Appears when autoattack on, disappears on off/kill.
46	- Driven by `GameLog.autoattack_changed(bool)` signal + `GameLog.set_autoattack(bool)`.
47	
48	**Action bar (Scenes/action_bar.tscn + Scripts/action_bar.gd)**
49	- 12 slots: keys 1–9, 0, -, =
50	- Bottom-center of screen, built entirely in _ready() (no layout in .tscn).
51	- Filled slots show gold border tint and spell name (word-wrapped).
52	- On-cooldown slots show darkened overlay + countdown timer in seconds.
53	- Reads `player.known_spells` and `player._spell_cooldowns` via polling in _process().
54	
55	**Spell casting (player3d.gd)**

## 2026-06-08 — Session 2: Combat fixes, HUD improvements, action bar

### Bug Fixes

**combatnode.gd — `class_name` reserved keyword crash**
- `func set_class(class_name: String)` used a GDScript reserved keyword as a parameter.
- Renamed parameter to `new_class`. Game was unlaunchable until this fix.

**player_frame.gd — `get()` too many arguments**
- `_player.get("current_stamina", 0.0)` — GDScript's Object.get() takes 1 arg, not 2.
- Changed to ternary `_player.get("x") if "x" in _player else default`.

**combatnode.gd — ATK stat double-counted in damage**
- `calculate_melee_damage()` added `get_atk()` to raw damage.
- ATK is a hit-accuracy stat used in `calculate_hit_chance()`, not a damage bonus.
- Monsters had `gear_atk = 40 + level×10`; a level-2 skeleton was dealing 60+ base damage.
- Fix: removed `get_atk()` from damage formula. Damage is now `weapon_damage + str/2`.

**monster3d.gd — monster hit rate too high**
- `gear_atk = 40 + level×10` gave skeleton ~95% hit rate vs player AC 14.
- Changed to `gear_atk = 15 + level×5` (level-2 skeleton now ~55-60% hit rate).

**project.godot — A/D keys mapped to ui_left/ui_right**
- Caused TabContainer in game_log_window to switch tabs while strafing.
- Removed physical_keycode 65 (A) from ui_left and 68 (D) from ui_right.
- Arrow keys remain bound; A/D now only fire player movement actions.

**camera_controller.gd — mouse_mode conflict with Alt toggle**
- Removed Alt-key mouse toggle (unreliable).
- Replaced with right-click-hold for mouse look: MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED while held,
  MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE on release. Default mode is now VISIBLE (cursor free).

---

### New Features

**Combat log formatting**
- Monster attacks: "A hooded bandit hits you for 12 damage!" (description from monsters.json)
- Player attacks: "You hit/critically hit a hooded bandit with melee attack for X damage!"
- Parry/block/dodge/riposte all have distinct messages.
- `monster_description` field loaded from monsters.json in monster3d.gd.

**Autoattack indicator**
- Flashing red dot (⬤) added to top-right of game_log_window panel.
- Animated via Tween (fade in/out). Appears when autoattack on, disappears on off/kill.
- Driven by `GameLog.autoattack_changed(bool)` signal + `GameLog.set_autoattack(bool)`.

**Action bar (Scenes/action_bar.tscn + Scripts/action_bar.gd)**
- 12 slots: keys 1–9, 0, -, =
- Bottom-center of screen, built entirely in _ready() (no layout in .tscn).
- Filled slots show gold border tint and spell name (word-wrapped).
- On-cooldown slots show darkened overlay + countdown timer in seconds.
- Reads `player.known_spells` and `player._spell_cooldowns` via polling in _process().

**Spell casting (player3d.gd)**
- `cast_spell(spell_name)` — checks cooldown, mana, applies damage via
  `combat_node.calculate_spell_damage()`, logs to combat tab.
- `_tick_cooldowns(delta)` decrements per-spell timers each physics frame.
- `_spell_by_name` dict built alongside existing `_spell_cache` for O(1) name lookup.
- Keys 1–9, 0, -, = fire `cast_spell(known_spells[i])` from `_unhandled_input`.

**Starting equipment + weapon skill**
- `apply_equipment(equipment: Dict)` reads items.json, sets weapon_damage + gear_ac on CombatNode.
- Starting weapon_skill set by class on first load: Blademaster/Voidknight/etc = 10,
  ranged/martial = 8, caster = 4.
- Both trigger `recalculate_derived_stats()` after application.

**Dev character fallback**
- When launching a 3D scene directly from the editor (Global.player_data empty),
  player3d.gd now loads hardcoded Blademaster dev defaults instead of erroring out.

---

### Deprecations / Cleanup

**Data/character_stats.json — archived**
- Was never read by any active script (only by character_sheet.gd.old).
- Moved to archive-2d/Data/character_stats.json.
- Dev defaults now live inline in player3d.load_player_data_from_global().

---

## 2026-06-08 — Godot Startup Crash Fix

### Problem
Game crashed on startup with:
  Error at (36, 16): Could not parse global class "CombatNode" from "res://Scripts/combatnode-OLD.gd"

### Root Cause
.godot/uid_cache.bin contained stale UID entries for scripts that had been deleted
from the Scripts/ directory (backpack_ui-OLD.gd, character_creation-OLD.gd,
inventory-OLD.gd). Godot tried to resolve these UIDs on startup and failed.

### Fix
Deleted stale cache files and let Godot rebuild them on next launch:
  - .godot/uid_cache.bin
  - .godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg

### Also
Committed archive-2d/ directory to git as a versioned backup of deprecated 2D
scripts and scenes (combatnode-OLD, mob-OLD, player-OLD, backpack_ui-OLD, etc.).

10	CombatNode (Scripts/combatnode.gd) owns all combat math. Both Player3D and Monster own one as a child node instantiated in _ready().
11	
12	**7 base stats:** strength, constitution, dexterity, intelligence, wisdom, charisma, luck. This is the canonical stat list — agility was an old stat and is gone.
13	
14	**Resources:** current_hp / max_hp, current_mana / max_mana, current_stamina / max_stamina
15	
16	**Derived stats** (calculated via recalculate_derived_stats(), cached with dirty flag):
17	- AC = 10 + gear_ac + dex/2 + class_ac_bonus
18	- ATK = (weapon_skill×2) + str + dex/2 + gear_atk
19	- max_hp = 50 + (con×10) + gear_hp
20	- max_mana = 30 + (int+wis)×5 + gear_mana
21	- hp_regen per 6-sec tick = 1 + con/5
22	- mana_regen per 6-sec tick = 1 + wis/5
23	
24	**Combat resolution order** (resolve_attack): miss → riposte (parry+riposte rolls) → parry → block → dodge → hit
25	
26	**Monster CombatNode setup** (flat override approach — avoids formula mismatch):
27	- All base stats set to 0
28	- gear_ac = monsters.json armor_class - 10
29	- gear_hp = monsters.json health - 50
30	- gear_atk = 15 + level × 5 (level-2 skeleton ~55-60% hit rate vs player AC 14)
31	- weapon_damage = monsters.json damage
32	
33	**ATK is accuracy only** — `get_atk()` must NOT appear in `calculate_melee_damage()`. It was removed after causing monsters to deal 60+ base damage. Damage formula: `weapon_damage + int(strength / 2.0)` only.
34	
35	**Spell casting** (`player3d.cast_spell(spell_name)`): checks cooldown + mana, calls `combat_node.calculate_spell_damage()`, logs to combat tab, updates `_spell_cooldowns` dict. `_tick_cooldowns(delta)` decrements timers each physics frame.
36	
37	**Equipment application** (`player3d.apply_equipment(dict)`): reads items.json, sums weapon_damage from `primary` slot and gear_ac from all other slots, applies to CombatNode, triggers recalculate.
38	
39	**Starting weapon_skill by class:** Blademaster/Shadowblade/Voidknight/Lightsworn = 10, Woodstalker/Aetherfist/Zenblade = 8, casters = 4. Set on load if weapon_skill == 0.
40	
41	**Regen tick:** 6 seconds (EQ-style), not per-frame. Stamina regens per second.
42	
43	**Why:** resolve_attack() modifies BOTH sides' current_hp directly (riposte hits attacker). Callers must sync health bars after any resolve_attack() call.
44	
45	**How to apply:** After resolve_attack(), always check is_alive() on both sides and call sync_health_bar() on monsters. [[project-architecture]]

CombatNode (Scripts/combatnode.gd) owns all combat math. Both Player3D and Monster own one as a child node instantiated in _ready().

**7 base stats:** strength, constitution, dexterity, intelligence, wisdom, charisma, luck. This is the canonical stat list — agility was an old stat and is gone.

**Resources:** current_hp / max_hp, current_mana / max_mana, current_stamina / max_stamina

**Derived stats** (calculated via recalculate_derived_stats(), cached with dirty flag):
- AC = 10 + gear_ac + dex/2 + class_ac_bonus
- ATK = (weapon_skill×2) + str + dex/2 + gear_atk
- max_hp = 50 + (con×10) + gear_hp
- max_mana = 30 + (int+wis)×5 + gear_mana
- hp_regen per 6-sec tick = 1 + con/5
- mana_regen per 6-sec tick = 1 + wis/5

**Combat resolution order** (resolve_attack): miss → riposte (parry+riposte rolls) → parry → block → dodge → hit

**Monster CombatNode setup** (flat override approach — avoids formula mismatch):
- All base stats set to 0
- gear_ac = monsters.json armor_class - 10
- gear_hp = monsters.json health - 50
- gear_atk = 15 + level × 5 (level-2 skeleton ~55-60% hit rate vs player AC 14)
- weapon_damage = monsters.json damage

**ATK is accuracy only** — `get_atk()` must NOT appear in `calculate_melee_damage()`. It was removed after causing monsters to deal 60+ base damage. Damage formula: `weapon_damage + int(strength / 2.0)` only.

**Spell casting** (`player3d.cast_spell(spell_name)`): checks cooldown + mana, calls `combat_node.calculate_spell_damage()`, logs to combat tab, updates `_spell_cooldowns` dict. `_tick_cooldowns(delta)` decrements timers each physics frame.

**Equipment application** (`player3d.apply_equipment(dict)`): reads items.json, sums weapon_damage from `primary` slot and gear_ac from all other slots, applies to CombatNode, triggers recalculate.

**Starting weapon_skill by class:** Blademaster/Shadowblade/Voidknight/Lightsworn = 10, Woodstalker/Aetherfist/Zenblade = 8, casters = 4. Set on load if weapon_skill == 0.

**Regen tick:** 6 seconds (EQ-style), not per-frame. Stamina regens per second.

**Why:** resolve_attack() modifies BOTH sides' current_hp directly (riposte hits attacker). Callers must sync health bars after any resolve_attack() call.

---
name: project-save-data
description: "Character save file schema — what's stored, where, and what CombatNode calculates at runtime"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory

---

Save files live at `user://saves/<character_name>_character_stats.json`.

**Canonical save schema (post-refactor):**
```json
{
  "player_name": "string",
  "player_class": "string",
  "player_race": "string",
  "player_level": 1,
  "stats": {
    "strength": 10, "constitution": 10, "dexterity": 10,
    "intelligence": 10, "wisdom": 10, "charisma": 10, "luck": 10
  },
  "known_spells": [],
  "current_hp": -1,
  "current_mana": -1,
  "current_stamina": 100,
  "satiety": 100,
  "thirst": 100,
  "xp": 0, "xp_next_level": 100,
  "copper": 0, "silver": 0, "gold": 0, "platinum": 0,
  "resistances": { "acid": 0, "cold": 0, "fire": 0, "magic": 0, "psychic": 0 },
  "equipment": { ... },
  "inventory_data": { ... }
}
```

**NOT saved** (CombatNode calculates at load time from base stats): max_hp, max_mana, max_stamina, armor_class, crit_chance, spell_power, max_weight.

**current_hp convention:** -1 means "default to max" (new character). Actual current HP stored as positive int for in-progress saves.

**known_spells:** Array of spell **name strings** (e.g. `["power_strike", "battle_shout"]`). Spellbook only shows spells in this list — players must find/train/purchase/research spells before they appear. Master definitions live in Data/player_spells.json. Action bar slots 1–12 map to known_spells[0–11].

**Why:** The old "derived" section in saves (health, mana, crit_chance, spell_power, max_weight) was removed — CombatNode owns those calculations now. Old saves with derived sections still load; load_character_data() ignores unknown keys.

## 2026-06-08 — Session 3: Inventory, equipment persistence, draggable UI, pause menu

### New Features

**Starting inventory overhaul**
- New characters receive starting gear in the backpack, not auto-equipped.
- `basic_inventory[0]` = small_bag with: faded_note, iron_rations×20, water_flask×20, torch×5.
- `basic_inventory[1+]` = class-appropriate armor pieces + weapon (melee/ranger classes).
- Equipment slots all start empty; player manually equips via character sheet drag-and-drop.
- `character_creation.gd: build_starting_inventory(p_class)` handles all of this.
- `get_starting_equipment()` now returns all-empty slots.

**Equipment → CombatNode live sync**
- `Inventory.equipment_changed` signal connected in player3d._ready().
- `_apply_equipment_from_inventory()` reads live `Inventory.equipped` paperdoll and updates
  `combat_node.weapon_damage` + `gear_ac` immediately on equip/unequip.
- Equipment state saved to disk automatically after every equip change.

**Right-click to auto-equip (slot_button.gd)**
- Right-clicking an equippable item calls `Inventory.equip_item()` directly.
- Right-clicking a non-equippable item (consumables, misc) still shows the inspect popup.

**Save function (global.gd)**
- Added `Global.save_player_data_to_file()` — writes player_data to
  `user://saves/{name}_character_stats.json`.
- Called on equip, window drag release, and from the pause menu.

**Draggable UI windows**
- `game_log_window.gd`: 22px "Chat" title bar added above the VBox (Label with
  MOUSE_FILTER_STOP). Drag from the title strip to reposition.
- `action_bar.gd`: Click and hold anywhere on the bar to drag it. HBoxContainer set to
  MOUSE_FILTER_PASS so events bubble up to the Panel.

**Window position persistence**
- `Global.player_data["ui_positions"]` stores offset arrays keyed by window name.
- Each window saves position on mouse release, loads position on _ready().
- Persisted to disk via save_player_data_to_file().

- Buttons: Save Game, Save and Exit, Resume.
- Save Game writes file and logs "Game saved." to General tab.
- Save and Exit writes file then changes scene to main_menu.tscn.

## 2026-06-08 — Session 2: Combat fixes, HUD improvements, action bar

### Bug Fixes

**combatnode.gd — `class_name` reserved keyword crash**
- `func set_class(class_name: String)` used a GDScript reserved keyword as a parameter.
- Renamed parameter to `new_class`. Game was unlaunchable until this fix.

**player_frame.gd — `get()` too many arguments**
- `_player.get("current_stamina", 0.0)` — GDScript's Object.get() takes 1 arg, not 2.
- Changed to ternary `_player.get("x") if "x" in _player else default`.

**combatnode.gd — ATK stat double-counted in damage**
- `calculate_melee_damage()` added `get_atk()` to raw damage.
- ATK is a hit-accuracy stat used in `calculate_hit_chance()`, not a damage bonus.
- Monsters had `gear_atk = 40 + level×10`; a level-2 skeleton was dealing 60+ base damage.
- Fix: removed `get_atk()` from damage formula. Damage is now `weapon_damage + str/2`.

**monster3d.gd — monster hit rate too high**
- `gear_atk = 40 + level×10` gave skeleton ~95% hit rate vs player AC 14.
- Changed to `gear_atk = 15 + level×5` (level-2 skeleton now ~55-60% hit rate).

**project.godot — A/D keys mapped to ui_left/ui_right**
- Caused TabContainer in game_log_window to switch tabs while strafing.
- Removed physical_keycode 65 (A) from ui_left and 68 (D) from ui_right.
- Arrow keys remain bound; A/D now only fire player movement actions.

**camera_controller.gd — mouse_mode conflict with Alt toggle**
- Removed Alt-key mouse toggle (unreliable).
- Replaced with right-click-hold for mouse look: MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED while held,
  MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE on release. Default mode is now VISIBLE (cursor free).

---

### New Features

**Combat log formatting**
- Monster attacks: "A hooded bandit hits you for 12 damage!" (description from monsters.json)
- Player attacks: "You hit/critically hit a hooded bandit with melee attack for X damage!"
- Parry/block/dodge/riposte all have distinct messages.
- `monster_description` field loaded from monsters.json in monster3d.gd.

**Autoattack indicator**
- Flashing red dot (⬤) added to top-right of game_log_window panel.
- Animated via Tween (fade in/out). Appears when autoattack on, disappears on off/kill.
- Driven by `GameLog.autoattack_changed(bool)` signal + `GameLog.set_autoattack(bool)`.

**Action bar (Scenes/action_bar.tscn + Scripts/action_bar.gd)**
- 12 slots: keys 1–9, 0, -, =
- Bottom-center of screen, built entirely in _ready() (no layout in .tscn).
- Filled slots show gold border tint and spell name (word-wrapped).
- On-cooldown slots show darkened overlay + countdown timer in seconds.
- Reads `player.known_spells` and `player._spell_cooldowns` via polling in _process().

**Spell casting (player3d.gd)**
- `cast_spell(spell_name)` — checks cooldown, mana, applies damage via
  `combat_node.calculate_spell_damage()`, logs to combat tab.
- `_tick_cooldowns(delta)` decrements per-spell timers each physics frame.
- `_spell_by_name` dict built alongside existing `_spell_cache` for O(1) name lookup.
- Keys 1–9, 0, -, = fire `cast_spell(known_spells[i])` from `_unhandled_input`.

**Starting equipment + weapon skill**
- `apply_equipment(equipment: Dict)` reads items.json, sets weapon_damage + gear_ac on CombatNode.
- Starting weapon_skill set by class on first load: Blademaster/Voidknight/etc = 10,
  ranged/martial = 8, caster = 4.
- Both trigger `recalculate_derived_stats()` after application.

**Dev character fallback**
- When launching a 3D scene directly from the editor (Global.player_data empty),
  player3d.gd now loads hardcoded Blademaster dev defaults instead of erroring out.

---

### Deprecations / Cleanup

**Data/character_stats.json — archived**
- Was never read by any active script (only by character_sheet.gd.old).
- Moved to archive-2d/Data/character_stats.json.
- Dev defaults now live inline in player3d.load_player_data_from_global().

## 2026-06-08 — Godot Startup Crash Fix

### Problem
Game crashed on startup with:
  Error at (36, 16): Could not parse global class "CombatNode" from "res://Scripts/combatnode-OLD.gd"

### Root Cause
.godot/uid_cache.bin contained stale UID entries for scripts that had been deleted
from the Scripts/ directory (backpack_ui-OLD.gd, character_creation-OLD.gd,
inventory-OLD.gd). Godot tried to resolve these UIDs on startup and failed.

### Fix
Deleted stale cache files and let Godot rebuild them on next launch:
  - .godot/uid_cache.bin
  - .godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg

### Also
Committed archive-2d/ directory to git as a versioned backup of deprecated 2D
scripts and scenes (combatnode-OLD, mob-OLD, player-OLD, backpack_ui-OLD, etc.).

---
name: project-combat-system
description: "CombatNode design — stats, combat resolution, how players and monsters are wired to it"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: d6f652db-ff5d-490f-9513-2e10ddd5de2d
---

CombatNode (Scripts/combatnode.gd) owns all combat math. Both Player3D and Monster own one as a child node instantiated in _ready().

**7 base stats:** strength, constitution, dexterity, intelligence, wisdom, charisma, luck. This is the canonical stat list — agility was an old stat and is gone.

**Resources:** current_hp / max_hp, current_mana / max_mana, current_stamina / max_stamina

**Derived stats** (calculated via recalculate_derived_stats(), cached with dirty flag):
- AC = 10 + gear_ac + dex/2 + class_ac_bonus
- ATK = (weapon_skill×2) + str + dex/2 + gear_atk
- max_hp = 50 + (con×10) + gear_hp
- max_mana = 30 + (int+wis)×5 + gear_mana
- hp_regen per 6-sec tick = 1 + con/5
- mana_regen per 6-sec tick = 1 + wis/5

**Combat resolution order** (resolve_attack): miss → riposte (parry+riposte rolls) → parry → block → dodge → hit

**Monster CombatNode setup** (flat override approach — avoids formula mismatch):
- All base stats set to 0
- gear_ac = monsters.json armor_class - 10
- gear_hp = monsters.json health - 50
- gear_atk = 15 + level × 5 (level-2 skeleton ~55-60% hit rate vs player AC 14)
- weapon_damage = monsters.json damage

**ATK is accuracy only** — `get_atk()` must NOT appear in `calculate_melee_damage()`. It was removed after causing monsters to deal 60+ base damage. Damage formula: `weapon_damage + int(strength / 2.0)` only.

**Spell casting** (`player3d.cast_spell(spell_name)`): checks cooldown + mana, calls `combat_node.calculate_spell_damage()`, logs to combat tab, updates `_spell_cooldowns` dict. `_tick_cooldowns(delta)` decrements timers each physics frame.

**Equipment application** (`player3d.apply_equipment(dict)`): reads items.json, sums weapon_damage from `primary` slot and gear_ac from all other slots, applies to CombatNode, triggers recalculate.

**Starting weapon_skill by class:** Blademaster/Shadowblade/Voidknight/Lightsworn = 10, Woodstalker/Aetherfist/Zenblade = 8, casters = 4. Set on load if weapon_skill == 0.

**Regen tick:** 6 seconds (EQ-style), not per-frame. Stamina regens per second.

**Why:** resolve_attack() modifies BOTH sides' current_hp directly (riposte hits attacker). Callers must sync health bars after any resolve_attack() call.

**How to apply:** After resolve_attack(), always check is_alive() on both sides and call sync_health_bar() on monsters. [[project-architecture]]

-**Equipment application** (`player3d.apply_equipment(dict)`): reads items.json, sums weapon_damage from `primary` slot and gear_ac from all other slots, applies to CombatNode, triggers recalculate.

# pause_menu.gd — Pause / save menu opened with Escape
extends CanvasLayer

signal closed

func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 20
	_build_ui()


func _build_ui() -> void:
	# Dim overlay
	var overlay := ColorRect.new()
	overlay.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	overlay.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55)
	overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	add_child(overlay)

	# Centered panel
	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(260, 160)
	panel.anchor_left   = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top    = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right  = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left   = -130.0
	panel.offset_top    = -80.0
	panel.offset_right  =  130.0
	panel.offset_bottom =  80.0

	var bg := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	bg.bg_color     = Color(0.08, 0.07, 0.06, 0.97)
	bg.border_color = Color(0.45, 0.38, 0.25)
	bg.set_border_width_all(2)
	bg.set_corner_radius_all(5)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", bg)
	add_child(panel)

	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	vbox.offset_left   =  20.0
	vbox.offset_top    =  16.0
	vbox.offset_right  = -20.0
	vbox.offset_bottom = -16.0
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	panel.add_child(vbox)

	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = "— Paused —"
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.85, 0.78, 0.55))
	vbox.add_child(title)

	var save_btn := _make_button("Save Game")
	save_btn.pressed.connect(_on_save)
	vbox.add_child(save_btn)

	var exit_btn := _make_button("Save and Exit")
	exit_btn.pressed.connect(_on_save_and_exit)
	vbox.add_child(exit_btn)

	var resume_btn := _make_button("Resume")
	resume_btn.pressed.connect(_on_resume)
	vbox.add_child(resume_btn)


func _make_button(label: String) -> Button:
	var btn := Button.new()
	btn.text = label
	btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 34)
	return btn


func _on_save() -> void:
	Global.save_player_data_to_file()
	GameLog.log_general("[color=#88cc88]Game saved.[/color]")
	_on_resume()


func _on_save_and_exit() -> void:
	Global.save_player_data_to_file()
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://Scenes/main_menu.tscn")


func _on_resume() -> void:
	emit_signal("closed")
	queue_free()


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:

1. **Save and Exit** — `_on_save_and_exit()` never calls `queue_free()`, so the CanvasLayer (including its dim overlay) persists when the scene changes since it's a child of root, not the gameplay scene.

content.text:
Both fixes are done. To summarize:

**Save and Exit overlay** (`pause_menu.gd`)
- Added `queue_free()` before `change_scene_to_file()`. The CanvasLayer (and its dim overlay child) is freed before the scene swap happens, so nothing bleeds into the main menu.

**Repeat looting** (`corpse_loot_window.gd` + `monster3d.gd`)
- Removed `loot.duplicate(true)` from `setup()` — the window now holds a reference to the monster's actual `pending_loot` array. Every `Take` / `Loot All` action mutates the monster's array directly.
- Added `signal all_looted` to the window; emitted when `_rebuild_list()` finds the array empty.
- `open_loot_window()` connects `all_looted` → `_on_fully_looted()`, which sets `is_lootable = false` and despawns the corpse after 5 seconds (enough time for the player to see "Nothing left to loot." and close the window).
- The existing 60s auto-despawn timer in `die()` now checks `is_inside_tree()` before acting, so it safely exits if the monster was already despawned by the loot path.

**GameLog autoload** (Scripts/game_log.gd) — signal bus. Call GameLog.log_general(text) or GameLog.log_combat(text) from anywhere. UI listens via signals. No direct references between game code and UI.

**HUD scenes** (all spawned by Player3D._spawn_hud() at runtime, added to scene root):
- `Scenes/player_frame.tscn` (Scripts/player_frame.gd) — top-left, 220×130. Finds player via group "player". Shows name, HP (red), MP (blue), STA (yellow). Updates in _process().
- `Scenes/target_frame.tscn` (Scripts/target_frame.gd) — top-left beside player frame (offset 250). Con-colored name + level + HP bar. In group "target_frame". Updated via player3d._set_target_frame(node).
- `Scenes/game_log_window.tscn` (Scripts/game_log_window.gd) — bottom-left, 470×200. Two tabs: General (non-combat) and Combat. RichTextLabel with scroll_following=true. Max 200 lines before clear.

**Con system colors** (target level - player level):
- Red: diff ≥ 5 (very dangerous)
- Orange: diff = 4
- Yellow: diff 2–3
- White: diff -1 to +1 (even)
- Blue: diff -2 to -3
- Green: diff -4 to -5
- Grey: diff ≤ -6 (trivial, no XP)

**Existing UI** (pre-dates this session):
- `Scenes/ui_bar.tscn` — bottom-right currency/HP/mana/XP labels (legacy, 2D scene)
- `Scenes/character_sheet.tscn` — full stat sheet, opened via toggle_character_sheet()
- `Scenes/backpack_ui.tscn` — inventory grid
- `Scenes/corpse_loot_window.tscn` — looting interface

**Action bar** (`Scenes/action_bar.tscn` / `Scripts/action_bar.gd`) — bottom-center, 12 slots (keys 1–9, 0, -, =). Built entirely in _ready(), no layout in .tscn. Polls `player.known_spells` and `player._spell_cooldowns` in _process(). Filled slots show gold border + spell name; cooldown slots darken with countdown timer. Spawned by _spawn_hud(). **Draggable** — click and hold anywhere on bar to reposition. Position saved to `ui_positions["action_bar"]` on drag release.

**Autoattack indicator** — flashing red ⬤ dot top-right of game_log_window panel. Driven by `GameLog.autoattack_changed(bool)` signal / `GameLog.set_autoattack(bool)`. Tween-animated fade in/out.

**Chat window** (`Scenes/game_log_window.tscn`) — has a 22px "Chat" drag bar at the top (added in code, pushes VBox down). Drag bar has MOUSE_FILTER_STOP so events don't reach the RichTextLabel. **Draggable**. Position saved to `ui_positions["chat"]` on drag release.

**Drag bar pattern** — RichTextLabel and VBoxContainer consume all mouse events before they reach their parent Panel. Solution: add a thin Label with `mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP` above the VBox and wire its `gui_input`. Also set HBoxContainer to `MOUSE_FILTER_PASS` when the panel itself must receive events bubbled from slot children.

**Right-click to equip** (`slot_button.gd`) — right-clicking an item with a valid equip slot calls `Inventory.equip_item()` directly. Non-equippable items still show the inspect popup.

**Window position persistence** — `Global.player_data["ui_positions"]` stores offset arrays per window key ("chat", "action_bar"). Saved to disk via `Global.save_player_data_to_file()` on drag release. Loaded in each window's `_ready()`.

**Pause menu** (`Scenes/pause_menu.tscn` / `Scripts/pause_menu.gd`) — Escape key opens a layer-20 modal. Three buttons: Save Game (writes file, logs confirmation, closes), Save and Exit (writes file, scene-changes to main_menu.tscn), Resume (closes). Escape also dismisses. Player3D owns `_pause_menu_instance` and `_toggle_pause_menu()`. Mouse released to VISIBLE when menu opens.

**Equipment → CombatNode live sync** — `Inventory.equipment_changed` signal connected to `player3d._on_equipment_changed()` in _ready(). Calls `_apply_equipment_from_inventory()` which reads `Inventory.equipped` (live paperdoll) and updates `combat_node.weapon_damage` + `gear_ac`. Also triggers `Global.save_player_data_to_file()` so equipment persists immediately.

**Save function** — `Global.save_player_data_to_file()` writes `player_data` dict to `user://saves/{name}_character_stats.json`. Called on equip, on window drag release, and from pause menu.

**Combat log format:**
- Monster hits player: `"A hooded bandit hits you for 12 damage!"` — pulls `description` from monsters.json
- Player hits monster: `"You hit/critically hit a hooded bandit with melee attack for X damage!"`
- Parry / block / dodge / riposte each have distinct messages

**Still to build:** spellbook UI. [[project-spellbook-design]]

Always check which script is the ACTIVE base class before making changes. mob.gd is deprecated; monster3d.gd (class_name Monster) is the real monster base. player3d.gd is the real player.

input.new_string:
Root-level nodes (added via `get_tree().root.add_child()`) survive `SceneTree.change_scene_to_file()` — only the current scene is freed. Always tag root-level HUD/overlay nodes with a group (e.g. "game_hud") and explicitly queue_free them before changing scene.

**Why:** The pause menu overlay and all HUD windows persisted into the main menu because they were root children, not scene children.

**How to apply:** Any CanvasLayer or UI node added directly to root should be in a named group. Scene exit code must free that group before `change_scene_to_file()`.

---

After an `await` in a node method (e.g. a despawn timer), always guard with `if not is_inside_tree(): return` before taking any action. If the node was freed by another path while the timer was running, the continuation will still fire.

**Why:** monster3d.die() had a 60s auto-despawn await. When the player fully looted the monster, `_on_fully_looted()` called queue_free() first. The 60s timer then resumed on a freed node.

**How to apply:** Every `await get_tree().create_timer(...)` in a node should be followed by `if not is_inside_tree(): return`.

---

When a popup window needs to mutate the caller's data (e.g. a loot window depleting a monster's loot array), pass the array by reference — do NOT call `.duplicate()`. Add a signal (e.g. `all_looted`) that fires when the array is empty, and let the caller connect to it for cleanup/despawn.

Root-level nodes (added via `get_tree().root.add_child()`) survive `SceneTree.change_scene_to_file()` — only the current scene is freed. Always tag root-level HUD/overlay nodes with a group (e.g. "game_hud") and explicitly queue_free them before changing scene.

**Why:** The pause menu overlay and all HUD windows persisted into the main menu because they were root children, not scene children.

**How to apply:** Any CanvasLayer or UI node added directly to root should be in a named group. Scene exit code must free that group before `change_scene_to_file()`.

---

After an `await` in a node method (e.g. a despawn timer), always guard with `if not is_inside_tree(): return` before taking any action. If the node was freed by another path while the timer was running, the continuation will still fire.

**Why:** monster3d.die() had a 60s auto-despawn await. When the player fully looted the monster, `_on_fully_looted()` called queue_free() first. The 60s timer then resumed on a freed node.

**How to apply:** Every `await get_tree().create_timer(...)` in a node should be followed by `if not is_inside_tree(): return`.

---

When a popup window needs to mutate the caller's data (e.g. a loot window depleting a monster's loot array), pass the array by reference — do NOT call `.duplicate()`. Add a signal (e.g. `all_looted`) that fires when the array is empty, and let the caller connect to it for cleanup/despawn.

**Why:** corpse_loot_window called `loot.duplicate(true)`, so the monster's pending_loot was never depleted. Monster stayed lootable forever.

---

name: feedback-godot-patterns
description: "Confirmed patterns and anti-patterns for this project's GDScript / Godot 4 code"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: feedback

Always check which script is the ACTIVE base class before making changes. mob.gd is deprecated; monster3d.gd (class_name Monster) is the real monster base. player3d.gd is the real player.

**Why:** Early in development, 2D versions (mob.gd, player.gd) were the active ones. Game moved to 3D. Spending time on mob.gd changes wasted effort.

**How to apply:** When asked to change monster behavior, default to monster3d.gd. When asked to change player behavior, default to player3d.gd. Only touch mob.gd / player.gd if explicitly asked about 2D scenes.

---

Use the GameLog autoload for any in-game message that should appear in the UI log, not print(). GameLog.log_combat() for combat events, GameLog.log_general() for everything else.

**Why:** print() only goes to console. Players need to see combat results in the UI.

**How to apply:** Any string that was previously a print() in combat code should be GameLog.log_combat(). System/world messages go to GameLog.log_general().

---

ProgressBar fill colors must be set via add_theme_stylebox_override("fill", StyleBoxFlat) in _ready() — not in tscn files (too complex to write by hand).

**Why:** Writing inline StyleBoxFlat resources in tscn format is error-prone and verbose.

---

When Godot crashes on startup with "Could not parse global class X from res://Scripts/foo.gd", the fix is to delete the stale Godot cache files and let the engine rebuild them:
  - .godot/uid_cache.bin
  - .godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg

**Why:** The uid_cache.bin accumulates UIDs for scripts that have since been deleted or moved. Godot tries to resolve them on startup and fails.

**How to apply:** If a script was recently deleted/moved and Godot crashes with a class parse error, check uid_cache.bin with `strings` for stale paths, then delete both cache files. Godot rebuilds them automatically on next open.

## 2026-06-08 — Session 4: Bug fixes — save/exit cleanup, loot despawn

### Bug Fixes

**Save and Exit — pause menu overlay persisted on main menu**
- `_on_save_and_exit()` was calling `change_scene_to_file()` without freeing the
  PauseMenu CanvasLayer first. Root-level nodes survive scene changes.
- Fix: added `queue_free()` before `change_scene_to_file()` in pause_menu.gd.

**Save and Exit — HUD (chat, action bar, frames) persisted on main menu**
- player_frame, target_frame, game_log_window, action_bar are all added to scene root
  in _spawn_hud() and survive `change_scene_to_file()`.
- Fix: all HUD nodes now tagged with group `"game_hud"` on spawn. `_on_save_and_exit()`
  iterates the group and queue_frees every node before changing scene.

**Monster — lootable infinitely after being looted**
- `corpse_loot_window.setup()` called `loot.duplicate(true)`, giving the window its own
  copy. Items taken from the window never depleted the monster's `pending_loot`, so
  `is_lootable` stayed true and the window could be reopened with full loot each time.
- Fix: removed `.duplicate(true)` — the window now holds a direct reference to the
  monster's array. `_take()` / `_loot_all()` mutate it in place.
- Added `signal all_looted` to corpse_loot_window, emitted when `_rebuild_list()` finds
  the array empty. `open_loot_window()` connects this to `_on_fully_looted()` which sets
  `is_lootable = false` and despawns the corpse after 5 seconds.
- Added `if not is_inside_tree(): return` guard in `die()`'s 60s auto-despawn await so
  it safely exits if the corpse was already freed via the loot path.

## 2026-06-08 — Session 3: Inventory, equipment persistence, draggable UI, pause menu

### New Features

**Starting inventory overhaul**
- New characters receive starting gear in the backpack, not auto-equipped.
- `basic_inventory[0]` = small_bag with: faded_note, iron_rations×20, water_flask×20, torch×5.
- `basic_inventory[1+]` = class-appropriate armor pieces + weapon (melee/ranger classes).
- Equipment slots all start empty; player manually equips via character sheet drag-and-drop.
- `character_creation.gd: build_starting_inventory(p_class)` handles all of this.
- `get_starting_equipment()` now returns all-empty slots.

**Equipment → CombatNode live sync**
- `Inventory.equipment_changed` signal connected in player3d._ready().
- `_apply_equipment_from_inventory()` reads live `Inventory.equipped` paperdoll and updates
  `combat_node.weapon_damage` + `gear_ac` immediately on equip/unequip.
- Equipment state saved to disk automatically after every equip change.

**Right-click to auto-equip (slot_button.gd)**
- Right-clicking an equippable item calls `Inventory.equip_item()` directly.
- Right-clicking a non-equippable item (consumables, misc) still shows the inspect popup.

**Save function (global.gd)**
- Added `Global.save_player_data_to_file()` — writes player_data to
  `user://saves/{name}_character_stats.json`.
- Called on equip, window drag release, and from the pause menu.

**Draggable UI windows**
- `game_log_window.gd`: 22px "Chat" title bar added above the VBox (Label with
  MOUSE_FILTER_STOP). Drag from the title strip to reposition.
- `action_bar.gd`: Click and hold anywhere on the bar to drag it. HBoxContainer set to
  MOUSE_FILTER_PASS so events bubble up to the Panel.

**Window position persistence**
- `Global.player_data["ui_positions"]` stores offset arrays keyed by window name.
- Each window saves position on mouse release, loads position on _ready().
- Persisted to disk via save_player_data_to_file().

**Pause menu (pause_menu.gd + pause_menu.tscn)**
- Escape key opens a centered modal (layer 20) with a dim overlay.
- Buttons: Save Game, Save and Exit, Resume.
- Save Game writes file and logs "Game saved." to General tab.
- Save and Exit writes file then changes scene to main_menu.tscn.
- Escape also dismisses the menu. Player3D owns the instance reference.

---

## 2026-06-08 — Session 2: Combat fixes, HUD improvements, action bar

### Bug Fixes

**combatnode.gd — `class_name` reserved keyword crash**
- `func set_class(class_name: String)` used a GDScript reserved keyword as a parameter.
- Renamed parameter to `new_class`. Game was unlaunchable until this fix.

**player_frame.gd — `get()` too many arguments**
- `_player.get("current_stamina", 0.0)` — GDScript's Object.get() takes 1 arg, not 2.
- Changed to ternary `_player.get("x") if "x" in _player else default`.

**combatnode.gd — ATK stat double-counted in damage**
- `calculate_melee_damage()` added `get_atk()` to raw damage.
- ATK is a hit-accuracy stat used in `calculate_hit_chance()`, not a damage bonus.
- Monsters had `gear_atk = 40 + level×10`; a level-2 skeleton was dealing 60+ base damage.
- Fix: removed `get_atk()` from damage formula. Damage is now `weapon_damage + str/2`.

**monster3d.gd — monster hit rate too high**
- `gear_atk = 40 + level×10` gave skeleton ~95% hit rate vs player AC 14.
- Changed to `gear_atk = 15 + level×5` (level-2 skeleton now ~55-60% hit rate).

**project.godot — A/D keys mapped to ui_left/ui_right**
- Caused TabContainer in game_log_window to switch tabs while strafing.
- Removed physical_keycode 65 (A) from ui_left and 68 (D) from ui_right.
- Arrow keys remain bound; A/D now only fire player movement actions.

**camera_controller.gd — mouse_mode conflict with Alt toggle**
- Removed Alt-key mouse toggle (unreliable).
- Replaced with right-click-hold for mouse look: MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED while held,
  MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE on release. Default mode is now VISIBLE (cursor free).

---

### New Features

**Combat log formatting**
- Monster attacks: "A hooded bandit hits you for 12 damage!" (description from monsters.json)
- Player attacks: "You hit/critically hit a hooded bandit with melee attack for X damage!"
- Parry/block/dodge/riposte all have distinct messages.
- `monster_description` field loaded from monsters.json in monster3d.gd.

**Autoattack indicator**
- Flashing red dot (⬤) added to top-right of game_log_window panel.
- Animated via Tween (fade in/out). Appears when autoattack on, disappears on off/kill.
- Driven by `GameLog.autoattack_changed(bool)` signal + `GameLog.set_autoattack(bool)`.

**Action bar (Scenes/action_bar.tscn + Scripts/action_bar.gd)**
- 12 slots: keys 1–9, 0, -, =
- Bottom-center of screen, built entirely in _ready() (no layout in .tscn).
- Filled slots show gold border tint and spell name (word-wrapped).
- On-cooldown slots show darkened overlay + countdown timer in seconds.
- Reads `player.known_spells` and `player._spell_cooldowns` via polling in _process().

**Spell casting (player3d.gd)**
- `cast_spell(spell_name)` — checks cooldown, mana, applies damage via
  `combat_node.calculate_spell_damage()`, logs to combat tab.
- `_tick_cooldowns(delta)` decrements per-spell timers each physics frame.
- `_spell_by_name` dict built alongside existing `_spell_cache` for O(1) name lookup.
- Keys 1–9, 0, -, = fire `cast_spell(known_spells[i])` from `_unhandled_input`.

**Starting equipment + weapon skill**
- `apply_equipment(equipment: Dict)` reads items.json, sets weapon_damage + gear_ac on CombatNode.
- Starting weapon_skill set by class on first load: Blademaster/Voidknight/etc = 10,
  ranged/martial = 8, caster = 4.
- Both trigger `recalculate_derived_stats()` after application.

**Dev character fallback**
- When launching a 3D scene directly from the editor (Global.player_data empty),
  player3d.gd now loads hardcoded Blademaster dev defaults instead of erroring out.

---

### Deprecations / Cleanup

**Data/character_stats.json — archived**
- Was never read by any active script (only by character_sheet.gd.old).
- Moved to archive-2d/Data/character_stats.json.
- Dev defaults now live inline in player3d.load_player_data_from_global().

---

## 2026-06-08 — Godot Startup Crash Fix

### Problem
Game crashed on startup with:
  Error at (36, 16): Could not parse global class "CombatNode" from "res://Scripts/combatnode-OLD.gd"

### Root Cause
.godot/uid_cache.bin contained stale UID entries for scripts that had been deleted
from the Scripts/ directory (backpack_ui-OLD.gd, character_creation-OLD.gd,
inventory-OLD.gd). Godot tried to resolve these UIDs on startup and failed.

### Fix
Deleted stale cache files and let Godot rebuild them on next launch:
  - .godot/uid_cache.bin
  - .godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg

### Also
Committed archive-2d/ directory to git as a versioned backup of deprecated 2D
scripts and scenes (combatnode-OLD, mob-OLD, player-OLD, backpack_ui-OLD, etc.).
